register.title: Create your agency workspace
register.intro: Register the agency owner first. Email verification and platform activation are both required before operations begin.
register.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only.
register.pendingBody: The workspace is pending email verification and platform approval. Services are not active yet.

login.title: Sign in to Raak
login.intro: Your agency is resolved from this workspace address. The same email can belong to separate agencies without sharing access.

verify.title: Verify the owner email
verify.intro: For security, verification is completed only after you press the button. Email scanners cannot activate the account automatically.
verify.success: Email verified. Your agency remains pending platform activation.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.intro: The new password replaces the old credential and signs out every existing session for this account.
reset.missing: This password reset link is incomplete.
reset.success: Password updated. Existing sessions were signed out.

invitation.title: Set up your staff account
invitation.intro: Choose a password to accept this tenant-bound invitation. Your role and agency cannot be changed from this link.
invitation.success: Invitation accepted. You can now sign in from your agency workspace.

validation.slug: Choose a valid, non-reserved workspace address.
validation.request: The request could not be completed. Check the details and try again.
